Answers to Questions: Case 1
1. What additional information is important to obtain from a patient who presents with 
these symptoms?
Assessment of a patient’s alcohol intake should always be included in the social history because 
many people who actively drink alcohol may not voluntarily admit to having a drinking problem 
and at-risk alcohol consumption is often asymptomatic. Particular attention must be paid to those 
signs, symptoms, and lab tests that are likely to be abnormal in the alcoholic patient. Neurologic
